notes.title: Innocence Or Money: Season 2 - Steam page creation this week!
notes.content:
Hello people! 👋 This will be a long post, so get your popcorn and get comfortable! 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/963ff684cbd7e0bba70ebdf6ce5a573057f28927.png[/img]

First off, I need to extend my sincerest apologies for the radio silence over the past month here on Steam. If you've reached out via Steam messages or the forums and haven't heard back, or if you've sent me a friend invite that's gathered virtual dust, I'm truly sorry. I'm not inactive, far from it—I’m laser-focused on game development, and sadly that has left me with little to no time to respond. I appreciate your understanding and patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/443f8f61162fbbdfd1bff5096196ca03a2f26b01.png[/img]

But today, I come bearing exciting news! 🤩

Season 2, Episode 1 is on the cusp of completion! I've taken your feedback to heart, especially concerning the pacing of Season 1's release. Unlike last time, where Episode 3 dropped on Steam and everyone was left waiting for what felt like eons for the entire season to be available, I’m shaking things up.

I'm thrilled to announce that Season 2 will debut as an "early access" title. Those who jump in early will get to experience each episode hot off the press as they are completed. It's a way to keep the adventure going without the lengthy intermissions!

In addition, many of you know that Innocence Or Money (IoM) is available across multiple platforms. There have been occasions when a release has hit another platform before Steam (no specifics mentioned to keep the peace with community guidelines hehe 😅), but that's changing. From now on, simultaneous releases are the new norm! Every platform will receive updates concurrently, same day, same hour. This way, I make sure no one is left out and everyone can dive into the IoM universe together, no matter the platform. 😍

This week I will be creating the Steam store page and I will also send the game for approval, the current status of Season 2 Episode 1 is the following: 

--- GAME STATUS ---

[b]IMAGES:[/b] 1.686 (100% Finished)
[b]ANIMATIONS:[/b] 503!!! 🤩 (100% Finished)
I pushed myself to reach this number; now we have more cameras than Fred! 😎🎥
[b]TEXT/STORY:[/b] 100% Finished
[b]CODING:[/b] 95% Finished
[b]TRANSLATIONS:[/b] 25% Finished
[b]SOUNDS:[/b] 20% FInished

The game code has been modified from the core, and episode 1 of the second season is a base on which I will be able to build and develop many new things and take the IoM world to a new level. In the following months, a lot of new functionalities will be added during the development of Season 2.

---

Let's go with some pics and information.

[b]2 New languages will be added:[/b]
* Arabic
* Spanish (Latin America)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/4c8ef684e4a8354f668f71e7cdd5f0e17db5e6ea.png[/img]

[b]The music player will have some new functionality (This is an old pic, the final one is ready but it's a surprise, so I'm not showing it 😉)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/babfd0075bf3d5bf26be38b68fffb72d3f9b9c3d.png[/img]

[b]The floors of the gym bathrooms were upgraded with anti-slip coatings (Please note only the new floor, there is nothing else to see in this picture...) 😁[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/40d347feb733e56520bc298fe1028554cd125fec.png[/img]

[b]The first episode of season 2 has the corruption/money route as its main focus; however, details of the innocence route have also been worked on, such as Jennifer wearing her first uniform in the cafeteria. (I don't think many will see this image in the game so I'm posting it here 😂)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/417b5b2e022f9827e7360cdfff44f6357b0f02a9.png[/img]

The first episode of season 2 has taken me many months of development, but I am satisfied with the content and it is in the final stretch, once Steam approves it I will inform you all to start the countdown to launch!

Make sure you read the whole story and go through the quests, if you don't, you might miss a scene like this one that is already included in the game... [b](HUGE SPOILER COMING!!!)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/89725cf15c0b1a6a2f916815f4fb92dcc4744f5e.png[/img]

🤩🤩🤩

I hope soon to be announcing the good news of the launch 🚀, I wish you all a great week and again I apologize for not answering the messages (dm / forum / invitations), I think I won't be able to answer them until the game is launched. Thanks to everyone! See ya! 👋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/9891ae7ebeebe089c07752e0b212c160da12c058.png[/img]

notes.title: Innocence Or Money: Season 2 Coming Soon to Steam!!!
notes.content:
Hello, people! 👋 I am incredibly grateful and thrilled to share that, thanks to your unwavering support, IoM has been a remarkable success on Steam. 🙏 Your enthusiasm and valuable feedback have been pivotal to the journey of the game, and I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to this amazing community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/a5ed19217f3f7f11bcf1ddf420f2504a8898eac2.png[/img]

It’s with great excitement that I announce that the second season will be released on Steam as "Early Access". This decision comes from a desire to bring you the story without unnecessary delays, allowing you to enjoy each chapter as it's completed rather than waiting for the full season.

I’ve prepared a preview of some images from Season 2, and I'm eager to walk you through the new functionalities and changes that have been implemented. 🙂

[b]All the images you will see are already included in the game and have been taken while I played the game.[/b]

[h2]Final city map for Episode 1 of Season 2. (New locations)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/de24a59c4cf40fdf36df192d4877e3adbb08332e.png[/img]
All the functionality of the house has been modified and the pillars on which IoM was built have been improved in order to develop something spectacular for our Jennifer. 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/474780804d2c03dd868b2121ce24d652daa158c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/59d806e1049b7579ea1c27182c99fa1dbd6d1941.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/b423fa76e0cda65cafcba17d3bd248978e0a6266.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/aebe15eeaa9f6a712fdc27846afab12dd7869360.png[/img]
[h2]The adventures continue[/h2]

The story will continue in every way and we will continue to see Jennifer's “progress” (if we can call it that) in the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/45f6b8dc249235af679ed922f19cf8602d223d89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/14da455ce55feae0956371099cb6907175ca78e8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/e47917aa3427e4cd02a716470da33129c32da86b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/153f3bc4df725f129f1a10629ca99a9c2f5ce836.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/ef54f92197e9cca148943288a7872d3808a76be1.png[/img]

[h2]New locations will be added to the map:[/h2]

[b]Cassandra´s Apartment[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/bcad926316ea6e3fa20ba49b32d56c4ff98a1761.png[/img]

[b]The Shopping Mall[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/8a6e5f00f71d8afd6e1d25ac8027378ffc17e112.png[/img]

[b]The Pharmacy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/904d32d51df5eb8f591725fda64160a9745b03ad.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements everywhere[/h2]

All the locations known so far have been improved and prepared for the future, here are 3 examples:

[b]New gym interface[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/7592d797195b35e366bd095883cfe84da28a21d6.png[/img]
[b]New electronic store interface[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/be72c3dee714c9a26662ff4ce4d874c625760196.png[/img]
[b]New coffee shop interface[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/23dd5032dccce26a40f3a169fa3fca7b80690f99.png[/img]

This is just a small glimpse of what's in store for the upcoming season. I'm diligently refining each aspect of the game to ensure Season 2 surpasses the first. The music player is undergoing a complete makeover, and you'll be introduced to new locations and characters. One of the exciting new features is giving Jennifer an inventory system, which will deepen the gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/4613ab29d3cbb0944b3c90813951642d753f6d60.png[/img]

I'm meticulously crafting everything to elevate the second season to new heights. To give you an idea of the content scale, Episode 1 of Season 2 is already packed with:

[b]Images: [/b]1073
[b]Animations: [/b]183 (Remember, IoM is animation-heavy, featuring multiple speeds, multiple angles, etc.)
[b]New locations: [/b]3
[b]New characters: [/b]3
[b]New tracks for the music player[/b]
[b]Much more...[/b]

While the number of new characters and locations is set, I am still in the process of creating more images and animations, so expect these numbers to grow.

The game isn't ready to be added to your Steam wishlist yet, as it's not finished. But once it's complete, I'll send it over to Steam, wait for approval, and then the countdown to launch will begin. 🤩

Thank you all so much, and I hope you'll love Episode 1 of Season 2 when it's released! 😍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/aaf2ffb377d0c3fb4c459f827a59e4f72b0eb66d.png[/img]

notes.title: Innocence Or Money Season 1 available as DLC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/69df4529a535e949ddc5e377352e17c6473a0755.png[/img]
All season 1 is now available! Continue to guide Jennifer through all the episodes of this season. You will meet new characters, new places and the decisions Jennifer will have to make will be crucial for her future. Her destiny is in your hands!

Steam page: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753550/Innocence_Or_Money_Season_1__The_Complete_Season_Episodes_1_to_8/]Innocence Or Money Season 1 DLC[/url]

- All episodes have been translated into 30 languages.
- All animations are now available in 4k / 60fps quality.
- All "hot" scenes now have sound (each character has their own sounds).
- The free version includes episodes 1 to 3, and season 1 includes episodes 1 to 8 plus a complete game remastering.

* Due to all the changes that have been made, starting a game from the beginning is highly recommended to avoid bugs that may arise due to incompatibility issues with older versions.

** The game will remain with the name "Innocence Or Money Season 1 - Episodes 1 to 3" even if you download the DLC. To make sure it is installed after purchasing it, you can check the game properties in Steam and see in the DLC section that the installation checkmark is checked (I will add some pictures below so you can see where you can check this).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/cefab8170145f7f196657493472e87a45d3d8adb.png[/img]

This is the first time I have published a DLC on Steam, I hope everything works correctly, but if any bug appears, just let me know to fix it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/9627339d63b43b7b5a09f55612d69bdc97c1b580.png[/img]

notes.title: Innocence or Money Steam News!
notes.content:
Hello people! I inform you that Innocence or Money will have many changes on Steam from now on, I will summarize below everything that is coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/8ed514c24933b724a1ce24b1a0917431cca6195d.png[/img]

A) The game will be renamed from "Innocence Or Money - V 0.03" to Innocence Or Money Season 1 - Episodes 1 to 3".
B) Everyone who owns this free version of the game will receive an update, in which:
[list]
[*]The game is now available in 30 languages. When you start the game it will ask you which language you want.
[*] The quality of the animations is increased to 4K/60fps.
[*] Sounds are improved
[*] Added sounds to the hot scenes
[*] New start menu
[*] And more stuff.
[/list]
C) I'm preparing the release of the entire season 1 here on Steam, it will be a DLC for those who want to support me in the development of the project (It is currently under review by the Steam team, as soon as they approve it will be published, consists of many more scenes, the continuation of the story, is already fully translated into 30 languages, absolutely all the animations have sounds and are developed in quality 4k/60fps and many more things).
D) The DLC will be called "Innocence Or Money Season 1 - The Complete Season (Episodes 1 to 8)".
E) The Steam page will undergo a major overhaul.
F) A new page will be created for the DLC.

The current version on Steam contains the first 3 episodes of Innocence or Money season 1, the DLC contains the entire first season and 100% remastered. I hope soon to be able to release the entire first season here. Greetings to all! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345436/271f279d6efafeb9b40681ba5a07c3ada6e3180e.png[/img]
